request.prompt: Create ONE original low-resolution PIXEL ART tactical scene. Image1 is the CHARACTER STYLE reference: extremely economical 12-16-pixel-like fantasy heroes, thick dark outlines, tiny simple eyes, few large color blocks, no textured armor or realistic anatomy. Image2 is the user's liked PALETTE/MOOD reference: muted sage olive ground, dusty blue stone/water, warm sand and earth, ivory, charcoal-plum background and small coral/red accents. Image3 is FLOOR GEOMETRY only: square grid cells projected as steep 4:3 diamonds, edge rise3/run4, not conventional shallow2:1. Use a flat connected roughly4x4 field, each character occupies one cell with feet well inside boundaries, generous empty space, NO plinths/discs/stands/rocks beneath feet. Scene: A small meadow field of quiet olive tiles, tiny broken stone gate at the back, sparse edge grass. Four heroes on separate cells. Four recognizable simple heroes inspired by image1: a cream-armored small knight with red shield and short sword, a green hooded archer with compact bow, a purple/blue short-robed mage with short plain staff, and a brown/teal rogue with short dagger. These are independent visual studies, no game role/canon changes. ALL FOUR heads, torsos, pelvises, feet and weapons are turned45 degrees toward screen LOWER RIGHT in a clear front-three-quarter isometric view. Show helmet/head tops and side planes. Faces point down-right; nearer shoulder and boot are lower on screen, far ones higher. Never symmetric frontal poses, never backs, never mixed facing. Make the diagonal turn obvious even at tiny resolution. Keep sprites truly tiny and economical with short limbs and clear silhouette; minimal stable colors for easy AI animation. Hard pixel edges, no smoothing, no texture noise, no gradients except very subtle background, no particles/glow, no text/UI/labels/watermark. Square canvas, whole small field visible with margins.
